name: UWC South East Asia
admission_notes: Application fee applies. Assessments and interviews for entry. Waitlists common. No priority for any nationality.
university_pathways: IB Diploma accepted by all Singapore autonomous universities (NUS, NTU, SMU, SUTD, SIT, SUSS) and globally. Score conversion varies by faculty.

name: Tanglin Trust School
admission_notes: British families given some priority historically. Entry assessments required. Strong pastoral care reputation.
university_pathways: IGCSE + IB Diploma pathway. Strong UK university placements (Russell Group). Singapore universities accept IB scores.

name: Anglo-Chinese School (International)
admission_notes: Part of the ACS family of schools. Entry tests in English and Mathematics. Methodist values.
university_pathways: IB Diploma recognised by all Singapore and international universities. ACS IP students from ACS(I) sit IB, not A-levels.

name: SJI International
admission_notes: Part of the SJI family. Full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, DP). Lasallian values. Entry assessments required.
university_pathways: Full IB programme. Strong local and international university placements.

name: Canadian International School
admission_notes: Bilingual stream (Chinese-English) available. Entry assessments. Two campuses across east and west Singapore.
university_pathways: Dual pathway: Ontario diploma or IB Diploma. Both accepted by Singapore and international universities.

name: Dulwich College (Singapore)
admission_notes: Part of the Dulwich College International network. British-style education with IB diploma. Modern campus facilities.
university_pathways: IGCSE + IB Diploma. Strong UK, US and Australian university placements.

name: GEMS World Academy
admission_notes: Part of GEMS Education global network. Full IB continuum. Newer school with modern facilities.
university_pathways: IB Diploma pathway to Singapore and international universities.

name: Nexus International School
admission_notes: Taylor's Education Group. Learner-led education philosophy. Inclusive admissions with learning support available.
university_pathways: IGCSE + IB pathway. Regional and international university placements.

name: Australian International School
admission_notes: Dual pathway: Australian HSC or IB Diploma. Strong Australian expat community. Rugby, cricket and outdoor education focus.
university_pathways: HSC ATAR or IB Diploma. Strong placements to Australian Group of 8 universities and Singapore universities.

name: German European School Singapore
admission_notes: Non-profit. German section and European section. Trilingual programme available (German/English/Mandarin). Lower fees than many international schools.
university_pathways: German Abitur or IB Diploma. Both accepted by Singapore and European universities.

name: Stamford American International School
admission_notes: Cognita group. Dual pathway: IB or AP. Strong STEM and performing arts programmes.
university_pathways: IB Diploma or AP scores + US diploma. Strong US university placements. Singapore universities accept both IB and AP.

name: ISS International School
admission_notes: Full IB continuum school. Known for inclusive education and strong learning support. Smaller class sizes.
university_pathways: IB Diploma accepted globally. Support for students with learning needs in university transition.

name: Hwa Chong International School
curricula: Preparatory programme for Hwa Chong JC
admission_notes: Feeder to Hwa Chong Institution (JC section). Primarily serves international students wanting to join Singapore's mainstream education. Entry tests in English and Mathematics.
university_pathways: Students may transition to Hwa Chong JC for A-levels, or take IGCSE and apply to other pathways.

name: Lycée Français de Singapour
admission_notes: Follows AEFE (French national curriculum abroad). French language required. Subsidised for French nationals. Non-profit.
university_pathways: French Baccalauréat accepted by Singapore universities (case by case) and globally. Strong pathway to French grandes écoles.

name: The Japanese School Singapore
curricula: Japanese national curriculum (elementary and lower secondary)
admission_notes: Serves Japanese expat community. Japanese language instruction. Students typically return to Japan for upper secondary education.
university_pathways: Most students return to Japan for high school and university. Some transfer to Singapore international schools for IB pathway.

name: Dover Court International School
admission_notes: Part of Nord Anglia Education. British curriculum through to IGCSE, then IB Diploma. Strong performing arts and STEAM programmes.
university_pathways: IGCSE + IB Diploma pathway. Strong UK and international university placements.

name: One World International School
admission_notes: More affordable international school option. Multiple campuses. IB framework with holistic education focus.
university_pathways: IB or IGCSE pathway to Singapore and international universities.

name: Chatsworth International School
admission_notes: Full IB continuum. Smaller school with community feel. Central location.
university_pathways: IB Diploma pathway. Placements to Singapore, UK, US and Australian universities.
